# f5xc_tcp_loadbalancer (Resource)

TcpLoadbalancer resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "f5xc_tcp_loadbalancer" "example" {
  name      = "example_tcp_loadbalancer"
  namespace = "example_namespace"
  port_choice = {
    listen_port = 1
  }
  hash_policy_choice = {
    hash_policy_choice_round_robin = true
  }
  loadbalancer_type = {
    tls_tcp = {
      tls_tcp = "example_tls_tcp"
    }
  }
  advertise_choice = {
    do_not_advertise = true
  }
  service_policy_choice = {
    active_service_policies = {
      active_service_policies = "example_active_service_policies"
    }
  }
  sni_default_lb_choice = {
    no_sni = true
  }
  cluster_retract_choice = {
    retract_cluster = true
  }
}
```

Domains starting with a Wildcard: *.foo.com. Not supported Domains: - Just a Wildcard: * - A Wildcard and TLD with no root Domain: *.com. - A Wildcard not matching a whole DNS label. e.g. *.foo.com and *.bar.foo.com are valid Wildcards however *bar.foo.com, *-bar.foo.com, and bar*.foo.com are all invalid. Additional notes: A Wildcard will not match empty string. e.g. *.foo.com will match bar.foo.com and baz-bar.foo.com but not .foo.com. The longest Wildcards match first. Only a single virtual host in the entire route configuration can match on *. Also a Domain must be unique across all virtual hosts within an advertise policy. Domains are also used for SNI matching if SNI is activated on the given TCP Load Balancer. Domains also indicate the list of names for which DNS resolution will be automatically resolved to IP addresses by the system.

<a id="nestedatt--cluster_retract_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_retract_choice`

Optional:

- `do_not_retract_cluster` (Boolean) do_not_retract_cluster When this option is configured, cluster with no healthy endpoints is not retracted from route having weighted cluster configuration.
- `retract_cluster` (Boolean) retract_cluster When this option is enabled, weighted cluster will not be considered for load balancing, if all its endpoints are unhealthy. Since the cluster with all unhealthy endpoints is removed, the traffic will be distributed among remaining clusters as per their weight. Also panic-threshold configuration is ignored for retracted cluster. This option is ignored when single destination cluster is configured for route


<a id="nestedatt--hash_policy_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hash_policy_choice`

Optional:

- `hash_policy_choice_least_active` (Boolean) Least Active Connections Connections are sent to origin server that has least active connections
- `hash_policy_choice_random` (Boolean) Random Connections are sent to all eligible origin servers in random fashion
- `hash_policy_choice_round_robin` (Boolean) Round Robin Connections are sent to all eligible origin servers in round robin fashion
- `hash_policy_choice_source_ip_stickiness` (Boolean) Source IP Stickiness Connections are sent to all eligible origin servers using hash of source ip. Consistent hashing algorithm, ring hash, is used to select origin server


<a id="nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `loadbalancer_type_choice`

Optional:

- `tcp` (Boolean) TCP TCP Load Balancer.
- `tls_tcp` (Attributes) TLS over TCP TLS over TCP load balancer with a custom public/private certificate. This is also known as BYOC (Bring Your Own Certificate). User is responsible for managing DNS to this load balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp))
- `tls_tcp_auto_cert` (Attributes) TLS over TCP with automatic certificate TLS over TCP load balancer with automatic public certificate provisioning. DNS records for the domains will be automatically managed by F5 Distributed Cloud. As a prerequisite, the domain must be delegated to F5 Distributed Cloud (see the DNS Management section) or a DNS CNAME record should be created in your DNS provider's portal(only for Domains not managed by F5 Distributed Cloud). ### Nested Schema for `loadbalancer_type_choice.tls_tcp.tls_certificates_choice.tls_parameters.tls_certificates`

Required:

- `certificate_url` (String) certificate_url TLS certificate. Certificate or certificate chain in PEM format including the PEM headers.
- `private_key` (Attributes) private_key TLS Private Key data in unencrypted PEM format including the PEM headers. The data may be optionally secured using BlindFold. TLS key has to match the accompanying certificate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--private_key))

Optional:

- `description` (String) description Description for the certificate
- `ocsp_stapling_choice` (Attributes) OCSP Response choice OCSP Stapling choice (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--ocsp_stapling_choice))

<a id="nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--private_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `loadbalancer_type_choice.tls_tcp.tls_certificates_choice.tls_parameters.tls_certificates.private_key`

Required:

- `secret_info_choice` (Attributes) SecretInfoOneof Secret can be one of the following types - * Blindfold Secret - Secret is managed by F5XC Secret Management System * Clear Secret - Secret is not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--private_key--secret_info_choice))

<a id="nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--private_key--secret_info_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `loadbalancer_type_choice.tls_tcp.tls_certificates_choice.tls_parameters.tls_certificates.private_key.secret_info_choice`

Optional:

- `blindfold_secret_info` (Attributes) Blindfold Secret Blindfold Secret is used for the secrets managed by F5XC Secret Management Service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--private_key--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info))
- `clear_secret_info` (Attributes) Clear Secret Clear Secret is used for the secrets that are not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--private_key--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info))

<a id="nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--private_key--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `loadbalancer_type_choice.tls_tcp.tls_certificates_choice.tls_parameters.tls_certificates.private_key.secret_info_choice.blindfold_secret_info`

Required:

- `location` (String) Location Location is the uri_ref. It could be in url format for string:/// Or it could be a path if the store provider is an http/https location

Optional:

- `decryption_provider` (String) Decryption Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the backend Secret Management service.
- `store_provider` (String) Store Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///


<a id="nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--private_key--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `loadbalancer_type_choice.tls_tcp.tls_certificates_choice.tls_parameters.tls_certificates.private_key.secret_info_choice.clear_secret_info`

Required:

- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL URL of the secret. Currently supported URL schemes is string:///. For string:/// scheme, Secret needs to be encoded Base64 format. When asked for this secret, caller will get Secret bytes after Base64 decoding.

Optional:

- `provider` (String) Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///




<a id="nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--ocsp_stapling_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `loadbalancer_type_choice.tls_tcp.tls_certificates_choice.tls_parameters.tls_certificates.ocsp_stapling_choice`

Optional:

- `custom_hash_algorithms` (Attributes) Use Custom Order for Hash Algorithms Use hash algorithms in the custom order. F5XC will try to fetch ocsp response from the CA in the given order. Additionally, LoadBalancer will not become active until ocspResponse cannot be fetched if the certificate has MustStaple extension set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--ocsp_stapling_choice--custom_hash_algorithms))
- `disable_ocsp_stapling` (Boolean) Disable OCSP Stapling Disable OCSP Stapling. F5XC will not fetch and staple OCSP Response for this certificate. This is the default behavior if no choice is selected.
- `use_system_defaults` (Boolean) Fetch with F5XC default settings Use F5XC Default Settings to fetch and staple OCSP Response. OCSP Response will be stapled if it can be fetched. Additionally, LoadBalancer will not become active until ocspResponse cannot be fetched if the certificate has MustStaple extension set. F5XC will try to fetch OCSPResponse with sha256 and sha1 as HashAlgorithm, in that order.

<a id="nestedatt--loadbalancer_type_choice--tls_tcp--tls_certificates_choice--tls_parameters--tls_certificates--ocsp_stapling_choice--custom_hash_algorithms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `loadbalancer_type_choice.tls_tcp.tls_certificates_choice.tls_parameters.tls_certificates.ocsp_stapling_choice.custom_hash_algorithms`

Required:

- `hash_algorithms` (List of String) <br>**Valid Options:** `["INVALID_HASH_ALGORITHM", "SHA256", "SHA1"]` (Multiple selection allowed)

<a id="nestedatt--service_policy_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_policy_choice`

Optional:

- `active_service_policies` (Attributes) Apply Specified Service Policies Apply the specified list of service policies and bypass the namespace service policy set (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_policy_choice--active_service_policies))
- `no_service_policies` (Boolean) Do Not Apply Service Policies Do not apply any service policies i.e. bypass the namespace service policy set
- `service_policies_from_namespace` (Boolean) Apply Namespace Service Policies Apply the active service policies configured as part of the namespace service policy set

<a id="nestedatt--service_policy_choice--active_service_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_policy_choice.active_service_policies`

Required:

- `policies` (Attributes List) policies Service Policies is a sequential engine where policies (and rules within the policy) are evaluated one after the other. It's important to define the correct order (policies evaluated from top to bottom in the list) for service policies, to get the intended result. For each request, its characteristics are evaluated based on the match criteria in each service policy starting at the top. If there is a match in the current policy, then the policy takes effect, and no more policies are evaluated. Otherwise, the next policy is evaluated. If all policies are evaluated and none match, then the request will be denied by default. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_policy_choice--active_service_policies--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--service_policy_choice--active_service_policies--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_policy_choice.active_service_policies.policies`

Required:

- `name` (String)
- `namespace` (String)

Read-Only:

- `tenant` (String)

- `sni` (Boolean) With SNI Enables Server Name Indication for Loadbalancer

<a id="nestedatt--origin_pools_weights"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origin_pools_weights`

Required:

- `pool_choice` (Attributes) Pool Choice Select origin pool method, simple origin pool method or more flexible cluster object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origin_pools_weights--pool_choice))

Optional:

- `endpoint_subsets` (Map of String) Origin Servers Subset Upstream origin pool may be configured to divide its origin servers into subsets based on metadata attached to the origin servers. Routes may then specify the metadata that a endpoint must match in order to be selected by the load balancer For origin servers which are discovered in K8S or Consul cluster, the label of the service is merged with endpoint's labels. In case of Consul, the label is derived from the 'Tag' field. For labels that are common between configured endpoint and discovered service, labels from discovered service takes precedence. List of key-value pairs that will be used as matching metadata. Only those origin servers of upstream origin pool which match this metadata will be selected for load balancing
- `priority` (Number) <br>**Default:** `1`
- `weight` (Number) <br>**Default:** `1`

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
